description: Source code for an LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) sample application using Zephyr RTOS, configuring VLANs, and parsing LLDP packets.

methods.name: set_optional_tlv
methods.description: Configures optional LLDP TLV with system name.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback for each network interface to identify Ethernet interfaces.

methods.name: setup_iface
methods.description: Sets up network interface with IPv4, IPv6 addresses, and VLAN tag.

methods.name: init_vlan
methods.description: Initializes VLAN configuration and interface setup.

methods.name: parse_lldp
methods.description: Parses LLDP packets received on an interface.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the application.
